name: Loaded RC filter
source:
// Loaded RC filter: ideal passives, finite output load, fixed electrical requirements.
param resistance: Ohm = 1kOhm
param capacitance: F = 159.154943nF
param load: Ohm = 10kOhm
net GND
net IN
net OUT
source VIN ac(1V)
resistor R1 {resistance}
capacitor C1 {capacitance}
resistor RL {load}
connect VIN.plus, R1.p1 to IN
connect VIN.minus, C1.p2, RL.p2 to GND
connect R1.p2, C1.p1, RL.p1 to OUT
simulate ac dec 60 10Hz 100kHz
assert gain_at(V(OUT),V(IN),100Hz) > 0.8
assert upper_cutoff(V(OUT),V(IN)) > 700Hz
assert upper_cutoff(V(OUT),V(IN)) < 2kHz
